description: Compares broadband coverage metrics across multiple geographies of the same type and returns a ranked table sorted by unserved or underserved population. Compares historical population coverage gaps; it cannot establish current BEAD eligibility or address service. Compares the first 300 distinct geography IDs and discloses duplicates, unmatched IDs and excluded IDs, or set compare_all_states=true for all 50 states + DC. Data is from FCC Form 477 (as of June 2021).

compare_all_states.description: When true, compares all 50 states + DC. Overrides geography_ids. Requires geography_type="state".

geography_ids.description: FIPS GEOIDs to compare. The first 300 distinct IDs are queried; remaining distinct IDs are disclosed as excluded. For all 50 states, omit and set compare_all_states=true.

geography_type.description: Geographic level to compare. Must be uniform across all geographies in the comparison.

sort_by.description: "unserved_pct" = share of population with no broadband (default). "unserved_pop" = raw headcount. "coverage_pct" = share with any coverage. "competitive_pct" = share with 2+ providers. Every option ranks worst-first, so rank 1 is the highest unserved share or headcount, or the lowest coverage or competitive share.

speed_down.description: Download key for a download/upload threshold pair in Mbps: 0.2=0.2/0.2, 4=4/1, 10=10/1, 25=25/3, 100=100/10, 250=250/25, 1000=1000/100. These historical population aggregates cannot establish current BEAD eligibility or address service; 100/10 does not establish 100/20 availability.

tech_filter.description: Any nonempty alphabetical combination of a=ADSL/DSL, c=cable, f=fiber, o=other (symmetric DSL, other copper, power line), s=satellite, w=fixed wireless. Default acfow excludes satellite; explicit acfosw includes every technology. acfow includes all fixed wireless and is not an exact program-technology eligibility filter.

name: fcc_compare_areas

appliedFilters.description: Filters and parameters applied to this comparison.

areas.description: Ranked comparison of geographies by the selected sort field.

items.description: Coverage metrics for one geography in the comparison.

competitivePct.description: Percentage with two or more providers.

coveragePct.description: Percentage with at least one provider.

name.description: Human-readable geography name if resolved (e.g., "Pontotoc County, MS").

noCoverage.description: Population with no providers at the given speed.

rank.description: Rank in the sorted comparison (1 = worst/lowest).

threeOrMore.description: Population with three or more providers.

dataVintage.description: Data vintage — Form 477 data as of June 2021.

duplicateIds.description: IDs repeated in the input, listed once in first repeated-occurrence order.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_data_found`: No area table data found for any of the requested geography IDs. `invalid_all_states_combo`: compare_all_states=true used with geography_type other than "state". `missing_geography_ids`: No geography_ids provided and compare_all_states is false. `invalid_geography_id_shape`: A geography_ids entry has a digit count that does not match the geography_type (state=2, county=5, cd=4, cbsa=5, place=7). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

excludedIds.description: Distinct geography IDs beyond the first 300, which were not queried.

notice.description: Composed disclosure naming unmatched retained IDs, excluded unqueried IDs and duplicate IDs with their counts. Absent when none applies.

unmatchedIds.description: Retained geography IDs without matching Area Table data.

title: Compare Broadband Coverage Across Areas
